اختصرتا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَصَرَتَا (iḵtaṣaratā) /ix.ta.sˤa.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# اُخْتُصِرَتَا (uḵtuṣiratā) /ux.tu.sˤi.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
